Public Lambda docstring example at monai/transforms/utility/array.py:305 is factually wrong and contradicts its own prose at lines 298-302. The prose says the example slices the spatial axes of a channel-first image while keeping batch and channel whole, but the code `x[:, 2:8, 3:9]` slices axis 1 (the channel axis, size 1, which yields length 0) and axis 2. By NumPy slicing semantics, np.zeros((1,1,10,10))[:, 2:8, 3:9] has shape (1, 0, 6, 10), not the stated (1, 1, 6, 6). The correct example would be x[:, :, 2:8, 3:9]. This is judged by reading NumPy semantics; nothing was executed.
The example is rendered into the API docs through docs/source/transforms.rst:348-350 (autoclass with :members:).
